            "Sales Date" TIMESTAMP,
            "Time of sale (code scan)" TIME,
            "Item Code" INTEGER,
            "Sales volume (kg)" REAL,
            "Unit price (yuan/kg)" REAL,
            "Sales type" TEXT,
            "Whether sold at a discount" TEXT,
            related_count INTEGER,
            related_sum REAL
        )
    ''')

    total_rows = len(sales_records)

    for i, row in tqdm(sales_records.iterrows(), total=total_rows, desc="Enriching"):
        # Convert row to dictionary
        row_dict = row.to_dict()
        
        # Execute subqueries
        count_query = f'''
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM purchase_price r
            WHERE r."Item Code" = {row_dict['Item Code']} 
            AND r."Date" = '{row_dict['Sales Date']}'
        '''
        count = pd.read_sql(count_query, conn).iloc[0,0]
        
        sum_query = f'''
            SELECT SUM("Wholesale price (yuan/kg)")
            FROM purchase_price r
            WHERE r."Item Code" = {row_dict['Item Code']} 
            AND r."Date" = '{row_dict['Sales Date']}'
        '''
        total_sum = pd.read_sql(sum_query, conn).iloc[0,0] or 0
        
        # Add enriched fields
        row_dict['related_count'] = count
